sources.title: Qwen3-1.7B-Base — specs, VRAM, license, benchmarks | LocalLLMs
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3-1.7B-Base is an open-source large language model developed by Alibaba's Qwen team and released in 2025. As part of the third generation of Qwen models, it delivers strong performance in text generation and conversational tasks while maintaining a compact 1.7 billion parameter footprint.

sources.title: Qwen3-1.7B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-1.7B Multilingual 1.7B parameter language model excelling in reasoning and code generation. Qwen3 is a multilingual large language model series from Alibaba Cloud, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen3 1.7B Base by Qwen (Alibaba) — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact base model that trades raw capability for efficiency — it handles straightforward language tasks with reasonable coherence but shows its size limits on complex reasoning or multi-step problems.
